title: QuizNet question bank
notes: The server serves the 10 lowest ids, in id order, to every student. The answer field never leaves the server before that question is submitted.

questions.text: Before application data flows, TCP establishes a connection using which sequence?

options.A: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK
options.B: ACK, SYN, FIN
options.D: ARP, DNS, DHCP

questions.text: Which statement about UDP is correct?

options.A: UDP retransmits every lost segment by default
options.B: UDP is connectionless and does not guarantee delivery
options.C: UDP always performs a three-way handshake
options.D: UDP reserves a dedicated circuit for the whole session

questions.text: A TCP or UDP port number identifies what on a host?

options.A: The MAC address of the network card
options.B: A specific application process or service
options.D: The length of the subnet mask

questions.text: Which port is the default for unencrypted HTTP?
An IPv4 address primarily identifies what?

options.A: One program running inside a computer
options.B: A host interface on an IP network
options.C: A physical switch port and nothing else
options.D: A single DNS cache entry

questions.text: In the client-server model used by QuizNet, who decides the score?

options.A: Each client, because it draws the answer buttons
options.B: The server, which checks the answer and stores the result
options.D: Whichever host sends the first SYN segment

questions.text: What is the main job of DNS?

options.A: Encrypt every TCP payload
options.B: Translate hostnames into IP addresses
options.D: Fragment Ethernet frames

questions.text: HTTPS protects ordinary HTTP by adding which protocol?

options.A: TLS
options.B: FTP
options.D: ICMP

questions.text: A phishing attack mainly tries to do what?

options.A: Flood a link until the router reboots
options.B: Trick a person into revealing a secret or running malware
options.C: Change the TCP congestion window legally
options.D: Duplicate a public IP across two continents

questions.text: In Python's socket module, which type is used for TCP?

options.A: socket.SOCK_DGRAM
options.B: socket.SOCK_STREAM
options.D: socket.SOCK_PACKET

questions.text: Routers forward packets using which OSI layer's addresses?

options.A: Physical layer
options.B: Data-link layer only
options.D: Session layer

questions.text: Which address is a private IPv4 address, not routed on the public Internet?
After a TCP server calls bind(), which call waits for new connections?

options.A: listen(), then accept()
options.B: connect(), then send()
options.D: select() is the only legal next call

questions.text: What does accept() return on a TCP server?

options.A: The original listening socket, reused for data
options.B: A new connected socket for that one client
options.D: The client's password

questions.text: 127.0.0.1 means which special IPv4 address?

options.A: The local loopback interface on this machine
options.B: The default gateway
options.C: A broadcast to the whole LAN
options.D: An unassigned public address

questions.text: In the CIA triad, confidentiality means what?

options.A: Data is hidden from people who are not allowed to see it
options.B: Data is available even if a disk fails
options.C: Data has not been modified in transit
options.D: The server answers within 120 seconds

questions.text: How does a cryptographic hash differ from encryption?

options.A: A hash is meant to be reversed with the same key
options.B: A hash is one-way; encryption can be reversed with the proper key
options.C: They are two names for the same operation
options.D: A hash always produces a longer message than the input

questions.text: A firewall's basic job is to do what?

options.A: Allow or block traffic according to rules
options.B: Replace IP addresses with MAC addresses
options.D: Assign domain names

questions.text: Why does QuizNet send messages with json instead of pickle?

options.A: pickle is faster and safer on untrusted sockets
options.B: Unpickling untrusted bytes can execute attacker-controlled code
options.D: pickle is required by the TCP standard

questions.text: Why are QuizNet's SQL statements written with '?' placeholders?

options.A: So usernames cannot change the shape of the query
options.B: Because SQLite rejects quoted strings
options.D: Placeholders disable the primary key

questions.text: Why can one Python process serve many QuizNet clients with threads?

options.A: Each thread blocks forever inside a single shared recv
options.B: While one thread waits on the network, others can run
options.C: Threads remove the need for a port number
options.D: The GIL stops all socket reads

questions.text: Which pair correctly matches the resource with its role?

options.A: RAM stores data only after power is removed
options.B: The CPU executes instructions; RAM holds data the CPU is using
options.C: A disk is faster than a register for every access
options.D: The ALU is a network cable

questions.text: Bandwidth and latency differ how?

options.A: Bandwidth is how much data can flow per second; latency is delay
options.B: They are identical measurements in milliseconds
options.C: Latency is measured only in megabits
options.D: Bandwidth is the number of cables in the wall

questions.text: QuizNet's JSON messages sit at which layer of the network stack, relative to TCP?

options.A: They replace the Internet Protocol
options.B: They are an application-layer protocol carried inside TCP
options.D: They are physical voltages on the wire
